items.title: Prohibited Countries
items.description: The company is crypto focused gaming site with minimal registration requirements. We need to understand how the company is blocking US, Dutch and sanctioned countries from playing on their site together with underage players.
items.notes: Customer Reply MetaWin employs multiple strategies to block users from restricted jurisdictions such as the US, Netherlands, and sanctioned countries, as well as underage players: Geolocation and IP Blocking: MetaWin uses geolocation services to detect the location of users attempting to access the platform. IP addresses from restricted countries are blocked from accessing the site. This ensures that users from the US, Netherlands, and sanctioned countries cannot participate in any gaming activities. KYC and Age Verification: Users are required to confirm their age on registration. Legal Compliance and Terms of Service: The Terms and Conditions explicitly state that users from restricted regions, including the US, Netherlands, and sanctioned countries, are not allowed to register or use the services. Any attempt to bypass these restrictions would be a violation of the terms, leading to account suspension or termination​​. “RESTRICTED REGIONS AND TERRITORIES ABSOLUTE RESTRICTIONS MetaWin will not permit Casino Games, games involving wagering to be supplied to any entity that operates in any of the below jurisdictions: Austria, Australia, Aruba, Bonaire, Curacao, France, The Netherlands, Saba, Statia, St. Maarten, Singapore, Spain, the United Kingdom, the USA and any other jurisdiction that the Central Government of Curacao deems online gambling illegal. This includes all of the named Nations' Territories and Possessions." Ongoing Monitoring: MetaWin continuously monitors for any attempts to bypass these restrictions, employing automated systems and manual checks to ensure compliance Method to be tested during audit to ensure it abides by prohibited and AML regulations.

items.title: Prohibited Countries 2
items.description: Please advise why some US states are allowed to register.
items.notes: Customer Reply MetaWin's Terms and Conditions state that users from the USA and its dependencies are not allowed to access Casino Games nor games involving wagering. Additionally, MetaWin clients will not have access to casino games under a Curacao license. However, there might be specific instances where users from certain jurisdictions within the US could access the platform Metawin.com to access other services: Jurisdictional Variances: Some US states might have different regulatory frameworks regarding competitions, no Curacaoz licensed Casino games. If any exceptions exist, they are based on thorough legal review and compliance with state-specific regulations. However, as a general rule, users from the US are restricted from using MetaWin's services. Technical and Legal Compliance: MetaWin continuously updates its systems and policies to align with evolving regulatory landscapes.
